name: promotion-editor
title: Promotion editor
description: Create and review a promotion with a live preview of every placement, a preview clock, a plain-language schedule in an explicit time zone and taste warnings. Owns no data.
docs: Requires Base UI primitives (a base-* shadcn project): ToggleGroup and Slider use array values. Pass `timeZone` so dates are entered in the campaign's zone, not the reviewer's.
